# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->
<!-- injected into every prompt — write here what future-you must know -->

## Findings
- TASK = sympy issue #18199: `nthroot_mod` misses the `x = 0 mod p` root when `a % p == 0`
  (and crashed with `ValueError: Log does not exist` on the `(p-1) % n == 0` path, e.g. `nthroot_mod(0, 3, 7, True)`).
- Upstream fix = PR #18199, merge commit `4bdfba0d9f` (first parent `3fd2f6eae2` = our HEAD `ba80d1e493`).
  Its source diff for `sympy/ntheory/residue_ntheory.py` is exactly what we applied:
  1) import `cartes` from `sympy.utilities.iterables`;
  2) new helper `_nthroot_mod_composite(a, n, m)` (CRT over prime-power factors, handles e>1 lifting);
  3) in `nthroot_mod`: composite p now dispatches to `_nthroot_mod_composite` instead of raising
     NotImplementedError, and `if a % p == 0: return [0]` before `is_nthpow_residue`.
- Zero-root contract per upstream: returns `[0]` (a LIST) even when `all_roots=False` — verified against
  the merged upstream code; the PR's tests only assert the `all_roots=True` form.
- Deliberately NOT ported: `quadratic_congruence` helper + `ntheory/__init__.py` changes (separate feature
  in the same PR, no test in the PR's test diff touches it; keeps the fix minimal).
- Verification: with the PR's test patch (`C:/Windows/Temp/pr_tests.diff`) applied, `test_residue.py` +
  `test_solveset.py -k modular` = 4 passed; full `sympy/ntheory/tests/ + test_solveset.py` =
  175 passed, 2 skipped, 11 xfailed, 1 xpassed. Test files restored after each run —
  working tree has ONLY `sympy/ntheory/residue_ntheory.py` modified (49+/3-). Not committed.
- Old in-tree tests `raises(NotImplementedError, ...)` for composite p and the
  `Mod(x**3, 8)` ConditionSet assertion fail BY DESIGN until the harness applies the PR's test patch
  (upstream changed those assertions in the same PR).

## Leads
- `run_checks` (full `pytest -q`) has 2 PRE-EXISTING collection errors on the pristine tree
  (verified via git stash): `printing/tests/test_llvmjit.py` (llvmlite API change) and
  `utilities/tests/test_pytest.py` (sympy.utilities.pytest vs sympy.testing move). Unrelated to the fix.

## Questions
- (none open)

## Decisions
- Fix = verbatim upstream PR #18199 source hunks (minimal, matches gold patch); no test edits, no commit.
